title: Enchantment Freedom
description: Now you can combine normally non-combinable enchantments! Included are some bonus Easter Egg features.
body:
## No more restrictions
### Combine what you want.

Enchantment Freedom removes the mutual exclusivity between vanilla enchantments, allowing you to combine previously incompatible ones.

### Current Features
- **All Exclusive Sets Removed** — Protection types (Protection, Fire, Blast, Projectile), Sharpness/Smite/Bane of Arthropods, Infinity/Mending, and all other vanilla exclusive groups now work together.
- **Hidden Easter Eggs** — A few surprise features included for curious players.

Simple, lightweight, and focused purely on breaking enchantment restrictions in the most straightforward way possible.

Perfect for god armor, hybrid weapons, or creative freedom in survival and multiplayer.


<details>
<summary>Future Plans</summary>

- Configurable toggles so that **you** can decide which exclusive set are combinable or not.
- Plus more non-traditional features.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

A few of the **Easter Eggs** are shown in the gallery image.

</details>
